project.objective: Learn what became of Juanita Ruth Kimbrell (b. 1921, Sedgwick County, Kansas) after 1940

questions.question: Where was Juanita Ruth Kimbrell living in 1950, and under what name?
questions.rationale: Selected as the next question; a plan already exists for it.

items.rationale: Juanita was 19 and single in her parents' 1940 household. The researcher recalls a family story that she married a man named Fenstermaker in the early 1940s; no marriage record is in hand and the marriage is unproven. The 1950 census is the next enumeration of her adult household.
